name: Jetboard Jetty
sources: LP1 1:12:00-1:20:52 (archive.org PS4 longplay Part 1; 2 fps frames, HUD counter crops)
camera: mixed: into-screen on foot; side-view raft rides and bonus; behind-the-rider jetboard (vehicle)
totalSource: HUD n/196 from LP1 1:12:21.5; ALL-boxes gem awarded LP1 1:20:52.5; gamepressure 196. GR's /197 is an off-by-one in its 194 entry.
typesNote: Crash 4 composition keys: wood (plain), question (?), bounceWumpa (crate with a gold wumpa emblem; GR 'fruit/bounce crate'; pays fruit per bounce), reinforced (metal-banded X-frame 'strong crate'; body slam or blast), iron (pale unbreakable metal crate, NOT counted; listed only in 'arrangement'), tnt, nitro (counted; the green ! Nitro switch detonates all remaining Nitro and they are added to the count), switch (iron ! box, not counted), outline (wireframe crate materialised by a !), phase (translucent blue crate that is solid only in one Lani-Loli phase), phaseTnt, fire (dark crate with brass vents that jet flame; GR 'fire crate'), checkpoint (counted), aku, unknown (type not resolvable from frames).

routes.basis: GR 117->139; needs the Green Gem from 2-3 Hit the Road

C1 beside the bonus pad; in the run it is broken after the bonus (70 -> 71 at 1:14:11)
side view; HUD 29/29; main counter 70 after transfer (1:14:02.5)
raft ride 1 (side view); C2 on a dock mid-ride; ! iron block materialises outline crates; GR 103
C3 + 4 reinforced crates; hidden gem on the 6 iron blocks to the left; GR 108

puzzles.summary: TNT on wood on a ! box opens the outline bridge
puzzles.solution: stomp the TNT, keep airborne off nearby crates until it blows; the ! fires and the outline row becomes crates/footing
puzzles.wrongOrder: standing on the ground beside the TNT or breaking the wood first

puzzles.summary: Nitro/TNT/? stack beside a loose TNT
puzzles.solution: light the loose TNT and let the chain take the stack
puzzles.wrongOrder: spinning the ? at the base drops TNT and Nitro onto the dock next to you
puzzles.loss: a life and the gem-path crates

puzzles.summary: phase bounce crate is the only way to a hidden crate
puzzles.solution: bounce up first, then break the bounce crate
puzzles.wrongOrder: break the bounce crate on arrival

puzzles.summary: ! under the dropping platforms materialises crates on the last dock
puzzles.solution: hit the ! before the platforms fall
puzzles.wrongOrder: ride the platforms and skip the switch
puzzles.loss: 2 crates, discovered only at the dock before jetboard 3

observations: Every vehicle run is preceded by a checkpoint (pier C1/C3, dock C5) and its crates sit on the boost line - high execution, no search.
The two count traps on foot are SUPPORT-ORDER problems (bounce crate before breaking it; ! before the platforms drop).
Nitro are part of the total: the ones the player avoids are paid by the detonator after the boss.
The optional green-gem path holds 22 of 196 crates (11 %) and the bonus 29 (15 %).
